title: EzCobbleWalls
description: Allows players to place a special block that grows a vertical wall up to build height.
body:
![Easy Cobblestone Walls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b273b86d604b9d69fd1f6f2be06e303b07b6f1f4.png)

Easily generate cobblestone or obsidian walls straight into the sky with a special block.

# ✨ Features
- Place enchanted cobblestone to generate a vertical wall.
- Works with cobblestone and obsidian variants.
- Great for building defenses or sky structures quickly.
- _/ezcobblestone_ to give the special Enchanted Cobblestone block
- _/ezobsidian_ to give the special Enchanted Obsidian block

# 📥 Installation
1. Place the .jar file into your server's plugins folder.
2. Restart or reload your server.

# 📂 Config
No config! Just plug and play.
